description: Snowflake CoCo Hackathon 2026 - GCC Edition From Data to Decisions — Build AI-Native Systems on Snowflake Go beyond experimentation. Build intelligent, production-ready data applications using Snowflake CoCo CLI . This program is designed for developers and data professionals who want to create systems that reason over data, automate workflows, and drive real-world outcomes . THE INITIATIVE Modern enterprises don’t need more dashboards. They need systems that understand data and act on it. The Snowflake CoCo Hackathon 2026 - GCC Edition is a structured program where developers and data professionals build AI-native applications using enterprise data . Through guided workshops and a hands-on build phase, you will design systems that: Design AI-native applications using enterprise data Develop modular, reusable workflows using Cortex Code Solve real-world problems across domains Deliver working systems — not just prototypes This is where data engineering meets AI execution . WHAT YOU WILL BUILD Participants will develop solutions aligned with real-world system design challenges: AI-driven workflow automation systems Intelligent data applications with natural language interaction Systems that combine structured + unstructured data Domain-specific AI copilots for enterprise use cases Each solution must demonstrate: Real-world applicability Modular architecture End-to-end workflow execution Meaningful use of Snowflake Cortex capabilities

problem_sources.text: Banking and NBFC teams manage real time fraud, liquidity and credit risk, and regulatory reporting (AML, Basel, and local regulations), largely manual today. Build a copilot that surfaces risk and fraud signals and produces audit ready regulatory outputs from natural language questions. · Combine transaction and account data with policy and filing text · Let a business or compliance user ask questions and get governed, explainable, evidence backed answers · Cover the flow from signal to evidence to a documented finding or report Judging Focus: Real World Relevance, Technical Execution, Solution Completeness
problem_sources.title: Risk, Fraud and Regulatory Intelligence Copilot

problem_sources.text: Insurers and lenders want a unified customer view to drive personalization, smarter underwriting, and churn reduction. Build an application that unifies structured and unstructured touchpoints (including call transcripts) into a 360 view and recommends the next best action. · Unify policyholder and customer data with unstructured interactions · Generate personalization, next best action, or sentiment insights · Move from a customer question to a recommended action in one experience Judging Focus: Real World Relevance, Technical Execution, Solution Completeness
problem_sources.title: Customer 360 and Next Best Action Engine

problem_sources.text: Manufacturers lose value to unplanned downtime because OT sensor data sits apart from ERP and maintenance context. Build a solution that converges IT and OT data to predict failures, automate work orders, and lift Overall Equipment Effectiveness. · Correlate real time sensor streams (vibration, temperature, RPM) with ERP and maintenance records · Predict failures in advance and support root cause investigation in natural language · Deliver a command center experience for alert triage and action Judging Focus: Real World Relevance, Technical Execution, Solution Completeness
problem_sources.title: Predictive Maintenance and OEE Command Center

problem_sources.text: Care and life sciences teams work across siloed EHR and claims data and dense unstructured documents. Build a copilot that unifies data into a patient or member 360 and answers clinical, safety, or regulatory questions with cited evidence. Use fully synthetic or de identified data only. · Combine structured records with unstructured clinical, regulatory, or legal documents · Produce risk stratification, evidence retrieval, or a cited answer, never opaque predictions · Deliver a question and answer experience with clear source evidence Judging Focus: Real World Relevance, Technical Execution, Solution Completeness
problem_sources.title: Patient and Member 360 and Clinical or Regulatory Document Copilot

problem_sources.text: Supply chain data is scattered across ERP, logistics, supplier, and IoT systems with inconsistent definitions, so the same question yields different answers across teams. Build an industry ontology, a business entity and relationship model (for example Supplier to Part to Plant to Shipment to Order to Customer), expressed as governed semantic views, so that a natural language layer returns consistent, trustworthy answers grounded in shared definitions and metrics. · Define the supply chain ontology: core entities, relationships, hierarchies, and canonical metrics (on time delivery, fill rate, days of inventory, landed cost) · Encode the ontology as semantic views so business meaning, not raw column names, drives answers · Layer governed conversational analytics on top so any team asks cross domain questions and gets one consistent answer · Demonstrate that the same metric resolves identically across personas (planning, procurement, logistics) Judging Focus: Real World Relevance, Technical Execution, Solution Completeness
problem_sources.title: Supply Chain Ontology and Governed Conversational Analytics

item.description:
Snowflake CoCo Hackathon 2026 - GCC Edition

From Data to Decisions — Build AI-Native Systems on Snowflake

Go beyond experimentation.
Build intelligent, production-ready data applications using Snowflake CoCo CLI.

This program is designed for developers and data professionals who want to create systems that reason over data, automate workflows, and drive real-world outcomes.

THE INITIATIVE

Modern enterprises don’t need more dashboards.
They need systems that understand data and act on it.

The Snowflake CoCo Hackathon 2026 - GCC Edition is a structured program where developers and data professionals build AI-native applications using enterprise data.

Through guided workshops and a hands-on build phase, you will design systems that:

  • Design AI-native applications using enterprise data
  • Develop modular, reusable workflows using Cortex Code
  • Solve real-world problems across domains
  • Deliver working systems — not just prototypes

This is where data engineering meets AI execution.

WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

Participants will develop solutions aligned with real-world system design challenges:

  • AI-driven workflow automation systems
  • Intelligent data applications with natural language interaction
  • Systems that combine structured + unstructured data
  • Domain-specific AI copilots for enterprise use cases

Each solution must demonstrate:

  • Real-world applicability
  • Modular architecture
  • End-to-end workflow execution
  • Meaningful use of Snowflake Cortex capabilities

Banking and NBFC teams manage real time fraud, liquidity and credit risk, and regulatory reporting (AML, Basel, and local regulations), largely manual today. Build a copilot that surfaces risk and fraud signals and produces audit ready regulatory outputs from natural language questions.

· Combine transaction and account data with policy and filing text
